literature_notes: The only ledger evidence (L1) is a C-terminally Flag-tagged Sertm2 knock-in used to demonstrate localization in spinal motor neurons. Per the authoritative topology landmarks, residues 59–90 are intracellular; the C-terminus (residue 90, Pro) is therefore on the cytoplasmic face. This insertion qualifies as a published tolerated tag, but it is not an extracellular surface site and cannot be promoted into `sites`. The extracellular span (residues 1–37) has no signal peptide and presents an N-terminal extracellular face, but no ledger line reports any tag or insertion there. Zero extracellular sites are supported by the ledger.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal Flag tag knocked into the endogenous A730046J19Rik locus; the C-terminus (residues 59–90) is intracellular per topology, so this is a cytoplasmic tag, not a surface tag.
